messages:
maya: Quick FYI — I'm starting onboarding for lyra-3b v1 weights into the registry. Source is HF path; need gateway authz + tokenizer sanity before we mirror. will attach manifest and checksums.

sam: thx. which HF path exactly? can you paste manifest / shard layout?

maya: hf://huggingface.co/open/lyra-3b/resolve/v1/manifest.json
```json
{
  "shards": ["weights-00001.bin", "weights-00002.bin"],
  "digest": "sha256:7a1f4e9b..."
}
```

ira: quick note: our mirror job presign TTL in CI defaults to 1h; for bulk mirror we usually set 6h. we should flag this in the ticket. :thinking:  

maya: created RN-4821 for presign TTL and authz mapping. also discovered tokenizer quirk: HF tokenizer reports pad_token_id = 0 while our serving layer expects -1 for 'no-pad'. might need a compatibility mapping or config rewrite.

nick: re tokenizer — is this the HF tokenizer file (tokenizer.json) or the `config.json` pad_token_id? sometimes HF uses 0 for <pad>, sometimes 1. if model checkpoints were exported differently it can mismatch. quick check: run `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('open/lyra-3b').pad_token_id)"`.

zara: PR for authz is up: https://git.redwood/dev/artifact-gateway/pull/1234 — adds policy to allow `mirror-ingest@redwood` role to GET presigned URLs and reads. CI locally passed but I saw one flaky s3 header test in staging.

sam: ran checksum compare locally — weights-00001 matches manifest. weights-00002 differs: local sha256 `6f2b9a...` vs manifest `6f2c1d...`.

maya: ack. I'll re-upload shard 2 to staging S3 and re-run checksum. calling out that our `manifest_validator` script flags size or digest mismatch so CI will fail until fixed.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: artifact-gateway/staging -> 2024-03-12T14:12Z :rocket: (PR 1234)

ira: after shard fix, can someone run `./scripts/validate_manifest.sh hf://open/lyra-3b/resolve/v1/manifest.json` — that does digest checks + tokenizer config lint. post full output in thread so we have an audit.

zara: will run the validator after deploy completes. also adding a small CI unit test to assert `pad_token_id` in tokenizer config equals expected value or we remap during load. saves future surprises.

maya: thanks — ping me @here when shard 2 is reuploaded, I'll kick the mirror job and run the validator myself.

sam: reuploaded weights-00002 to staging, rechecked checksum -> matches manifest now. :thumbsup:

maya: confirmed mirror started and staging->registry copy in progress. leaving thread open for post-mirror QA. if anyone sees tokenization mismatch in downstream evals, call it out here. thanks all!
